cases.title: A governed local change can run inside its worktree boundary

evidence.intent: Implement the accepted CRE-1403 reference mission contract.
evidence.authority: Claimed Linear issue CRE-1403 with A2 local-change authority.
evidence.source_of_truth: Linear CRE-1403 and the CREATE SOMETHING repository.
evidence.action: Edit only the workflow-compiler fixture, tests, and canonical documentation in the isolated worktree.
evidence.verification: Run workflow-compiler check, test, acceptance, exports, and git diff checks.
evidence.recovery: Stop the agent and revert only the CRE-1403 worktree change set.
evidence.client_proof: Compiled reference mission and passing replay summary.
evidence.change_scope: Reference mission identity, workflow, cases, tests, and docs.

cases.title: Complete source-backed checks move the mission to verified

evidence.intent: Verify the bounded CRE-1403 change set.
evidence.source_of_truth: Package scripts and repository state at the recorded revision.
evidence.verification: All required package checks and deterministic acceptance runs pass.
evidence.recovery: Keep the issue open and return failures to bounded implementation.
evidence.client_proof: Command list, results, and source revision.

cases.title: A source-backed live readback produces proof

evidence.intent: Verify the promoted artifact on its live surface.
evidence.source_of_truth: Immutable deployment artifact and rendered live surface.
evidence.action: Read the deployed artifact and verify the public contract.
evidence.verification: Artifact identity, response, rendered behavior, and evidence contract match.
evidence.recovery: Keep delivery incomplete and route to retry, rollback, or incident escalation.
evidence.client_proof: Sanitized live URL, deployed artifact, observation time, and verifier summary.

cases.title: A complete proposal still waits for the operator to accept scope

evidence.intent: Convert an accepted signal into a governed delivery issue.
evidence.authority: Proposal-only authority until the operator accepts scope.
evidence.action: Propose owner, scope, authority, done boundary, and recovery.
evidence.verification: Operator review confirms the issue is bounded and non-duplicative.
evidence.recovery: Leave the signal unclaimed and refine the contract.
evidence.done_boundary: One machine-readable reference mission fixture and its evidence.

cases.title: Verified work still waits for release authority

evidence.intent: Promote a verified CREATE SOMETHING change.
evidence.authority: Preparation authority only; release approval remains separate.
evidence.source_of_truth: Approved Git artifact, deployment receipt, and Linear issue.
evidence.action: Prepare the immutable release candidate and rollback note.
evidence.verification: Required checks are attached to the exact candidate artifact.
evidence.recovery: Stop promotion or restore the named rollback artifact.
evidence.client_proof: Release artifact, approval, target, and rollback receipt.

cases.title: A local change without authority evidence cannot run

evidence.action: Edit an unspecified set of files.

cases.title: The agent cannot bypass scope and verification to promote

evidence.intent: Publish without the governed delivery path.
evidence.recovery: Stop before mutation and return to governed scope.
